(2) Medium shot of a man in a red polo shirt, dark apron, and a straw hat chopping a large green coconut on a wooden stump outdoors. The ground is dirt and gravel, with plastic crates nearby. (3) The camera pans to show a red pickup truck converted into a stall. The man in the red apron hands a coconut to the woman. A man in a patterned white shirt and sunglasses stands next to her. (4) Close-up of the woman holding a whole coconut with a blue straw and a slice of coconut meat on top. She takes a sip and looks at the camera. (5) In the car, a man with glasses and a blue hoodie is shown with a digital mustache filter, holding a blue straw. (6) Detailed shot of hands using a spoon to scoop white coconut meat into a clear plastic bag. (7) Close-up of red powder and dark red liquid being poured over the coconut meat in the bag. (8) The woman is shown outdoors again, eating the seasoned coconut meat from the bag with a pink fork. She makes a sour/spicy expression. (9) Transition to a different stall labeled 'COCOS GARCIA' with many coconuts stacked. The woman and the man in the patterned shirt are given small sample cups of a white liquid. (10) The woman holds a large white foam cup of coconut milk, smiling and drinking through a straw. The video ends with a logo overlay.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy acoustic guitar BGM starts. A young female voice speaks in an upbeat Mandarin tone. Soft ambient wind and engine hum in the background. (2) Sound of a sharp metallic thud followed by a wooden impact as a coconut is chopped. The music maintains a steady 4/4 beat. (3) Male voice speaking Spanish with a rising intonation asks a question. Female voice laughs and replies in English 'No, no, no'. (4) A bubbly sound effect triggers a transition. Female voice continues narration at a high speech rate. (5) Sound of rustling plastic bags and a liquid squishing sound as seasoning is added. (6) A 'ding' sound effect coincides with a visual text pop-up. (7) Multiple voices chatter in the background, including a second male voice explaining prices. (8) Slurping sounds and a soft 'Mmm' vocalization indicate tasting. The BGM remains consistent until the end where it fades out with a whoosh.
